# API Contracts

<!-- Generated by /ai-context. Manual edits are overwritten on re-run. -->

## AS IS — Current state

No OpenAPI, GraphQL or JSON-Schema document exists anywhere in the repo. The contract is defined by `routes/web.php`, `routes/settings.php`, the two `TrainingSession*Request` classes and the 10 `app/Http/Resources/` classes, and is pinned by the Pest suite under `tests/Feature/Sessions/`.

Two surfaces: Inertia page responses (HTML on first load, `application/json` Inertia payload on subsequent visits) and a small owner-scoped JSON API under `/api`.

### Authentication

- Cookie-based Laravel session (`web` guard). `resources/js/lib/sessionTransport.ts` deliberately rides Inertia's HTTP client so the session cookie and `X-XSRF-TOKEN` travel — **there is no API token and no Sanctum**; `tests/Feature/Sessions/TrainingSessionCrudTest.php` asserts no `sanctum` middleware on any session route.
- All board and session routes sit behind `Route::middleware('auth')` (`routes/web.php`).
- `bootstrap/app.php` forces JSON error rendering when `$request->is('api/*')` or `$request->expectsJson()`.
- No route requires the `verified` middleware.

### HTTP endpoints

| Method | Path | Name | Auth | Success |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/` | `home` | public | 200 Inertia `Welcome` |
| GET | `/prancheta` | `board` | `auth` | 200 Inertia `Board` |
| GET | `/dashboard` | `dashboard` | `auth` | 200 Inertia `Dashboard` |
| GET | `/api/sessions` | `sessions.index` | `auth` | 200 `{"data":[…]}` |
| POST | `/api/sessions` | `sessions.store` | `auth` | 201 `{"data":{…}}` |
| GET | `/api/sessions/{trainingSession}` | `sessions.show` | `auth` + owner | 200 `{"data":{…}}` |
| POST | `/api/sessions/{trainingSession}/open` | `sessions.open` | `auth` + owner | 200 `{"data":{…}}` |
| PUT | `/api/sessions/{trainingSession}` | `sessions.update` | `auth` + owner | 200 `{"id":…,"updated_at":…}` |
| DELETE | `/api/sessions/{trainingSession}` | `sessions.destroy` | `auth` + owner | 204 no content |
| GET/PATCH/DELETE | `/settings/profile` | `profile.*` | `auth` | Inertia + redirect |
| GET | `/settings/security` | `security.edit` | `auth` + `RequirePassword` | Inertia |
| PUT | `/settings/password` | `user-password.update` | `auth` + `throttle:6,1` | redirect |
| GET | `/settings/appearance` | `appearance.edit` | `auth` | Inertia |
| GET | `/.well-known/passkey-endpoints` | `well-known.passkeys` | public | 200 JSON |
| GET | `/up` | — | public | framework health response |

Fortify contributes 36 more vendor routes (`php artisan route:list --only-vendor`): `login`, `register`, `logout`, `email/verify*`, `two-factor-challenge`, `user/two-factor-*`, `passkeys/*`, `user/confirm-password`. `password/reset` is absent — `Features::resetPasswords()` is commented out in `config/fortify.php`.

The clock always arrives paused: only `elapsed_seconds` travels, and the server holds no "running" state (`app/Http/Controllers/BoardController.php`).

### `GET /api/sessions` — session sheet

- Ordered `last_opened_at DESC, id DESC` — same tie-break as `CurrentSessionResolver`, so `data[0]` is always the current session.
- Scoped with `TrainingSession::ownedBy($request->user())`; `Gate::authorize('viewAny', …)`.
- Wrapped in `data` (unlike the board props, which are resolved to plain arrays).
- `user_id` is never emitted.

```json
{
  "data": [
    {
      "id": 12,
      "problem_id": 2,
      "duration_minutes": 60,
      "show_connection_order": true,
```

### `POST /api/sessions` — create session

Request carries at most 2 keys (`TrainingSessionStoreRequest`):

```json
{ "problem_id": 3, "duration_minutes": 60 }
```

| Field | Rules |
| --- | --- |
| `problem_id` | `sometimes`, `nullable`, `integer`, `Rule::exists('problems','id')` |
| `duration_minutes` | `sometimes`, `nullable`, `integer`, `Rule::in(session_durations.minutes)` → 30, 45, 60 |

Empty body is valid and yields the defaults. 201 response:

```json
{
  "data": {
    "id": 13,
    "problem_id": null,
    "duration_minutes": 45,
    "show_connection_order": true,
    "elapsed_seconds": 0,
    "notes": null,
    "nodes": [],
    "edges": [],
    "checks": [],
    "estimate": {
      "mode": "user",
      "dau": 1000000,
      "act": 10,
      "per_month": 10000000,
      "ratio": 100,
      "size": 1,
      "peak": 3,
      "ret": 3
    },
    "last_opened_at": "2026-08-22T21:10:00.000000Z",
    "updated_at": "2026-08-22T21:10:00.000000Z"
  }
}
```

Error cases: 422 with `{"message": "…", "errors": {"duration_minutes": ["A duração do treino é de 30, 45 ou 60 minutos."]}}` for minutes outside the lookup (15, 50, 90, 0, -45 are the dataset cases in `tests/Feature/Sessions/TrainingSessionCrudTest.php`); 422 `problem_id` → "Este problema não existe no catálogo."; 401 unauthenticated.

### `PUT /api/sessions/{trainingSession}` — autosave

Full-state write. Body shape is `SessionBody` (`resources/js/prancheta/session.ts`) and is exactly `autosaveBody()` in `tests/Pest.php`:

```json
{
  "problem_id": 1,
  "nodes": [
    { "id": "n1", "type": "api", "label": "API REST", "x": 320, "y": 180 },
    { "id": "n2", "type": "sql", "label": "Banco", "x": 520, "y": 180 }
  ],
  "edges": [
    { "id": "e1", "from": "n1", "to": "n2", "kind": "query", "label": "SELECT", "dashed": false, "bidir": false, "order": 1 }
  ],
  "checks": { "1": true, "4": false },
  "notes": "anotações do treino",
  "elapsed_seconds": 742,
  "show_connection_order": true,
  "duration_minutes": 60,
  "estimate": {
    "mode": "month",
    "dau": 0,
    "act": 0,
    "per_month": 500000000,
    "ratio": 100,
    "size": 1,
    "peak": 3,
    "ret": 3
  }
}
```

Response is intentionally minimal — the client already holds the state:

```json
{ "id": 12, "updated_at": "2026-08-22T21:04:11.000000Z" }
```

| Status | Cause |
| --- | --- |
| 200 | written inside `DB::transaction` by `SessionStateWriter` |
| 401 | unauthenticated (route binding aborts 401 when no `User`) |
| 404 | `{trainingSession}` belongs to another user — the owner-scoped `Route::bind` never finds it |
| 403 | `Gate::authorize('update', …)` denies (second lock) |
| 422 | any rule in `TrainingSessionUpdateRequest`: >200 nodes, >400 edges, label >60, notes >5000, unknown component/link slug, edge endpoint outside `nodes`, self-loop, `edges[].order` outside 1–400 or repeated inside the array, `checks` key not a `checklist_items.id`, duration outside 30/45/60, negative `elapsed_seconds` |
| 429 | throttling — the client waits `Retry-After` (default 20 s) and keeps the session dirty |

Sample 422 body:

```json
{
  "message": "O diagrama comporta no máximo 200 blocos.",
  "errors": {
    "nodes": ["O diagrama comporta no máximo 200 blocos."],
    "edges.0.to": ["Uma ligação precisa chegar a um bloco diferente do de origem."],
    "checks": ["O checklist é chaveado pelo id do item: [999] não é um item do catálogo."]
  }
}
```

Normalizations that never produce an error (`prepareForValidation`): negative estimate numbers → `0`; `null` for `nodes[].label`, `edges[].kind`, `edges[].label` → `""`. Nothing else is repaired — the connection order is never rewritten server-side.

Connection order travels in two places and is validated as follows:

| Field | Rules | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `show_connection_order` | `sometimes`, `boolean` | Global display flag, one per session; persisted on the column of the same name and cast `boolean` so the resource answers `true`/`false`, not `1`/`0`. |
| `edges[].order` | `sometimes`, `nullable`, `integer`, `min:1`, `max:400` (`MAX_EDGES`), plus `orderIsUniqueInTheDiagram()` | `null` means "outside the sequence". Two edges carrying the same number is a 422; **density is not checked** — a sparse `[1, 3, 4]` is stored exactly as sent. |

Keeping the non-null orders dense as `{1..N}` is the client's responsibility (`densify()` in `resources/js/canvas/order.ts` is the single exit point of every order mutation); the server only refuses what it could never repair. Order errors come back keyed by the offending index:

```json
{
  "message": "Duas ligações não podem ter o mesmo número de ordem.",
  "errors": {
    "edges.1.order": ["Duas ligações não podem ter o mesmo número de ordem."],
    "edges.2.order": ["A ordem da ligação vai até 400."]
  }
}
```

### `POST /api/sessions/{id}/open` and `DELETE /api/sessions/{id}`

- `open` sets `last_opened_at = now()` and returns the full `TrainingSessionResource` (`{"data": {...}}`); the previously current session is left untouched. The client then reloads the board through the normal boot path (`router.visit` with `preserveState: false`, `.ai/rules/js-prancheta.md`).
- `destroy` returns `204 No Content`, then re-runs `CurrentSessionResolver::resolve()` so the next-most-recent session is promoted — or an empty one is created when nothing remains.
- Both: 404 for a non-owned id, 403 from the policy, 401 unauthenticated.

### `GET /.well-known/passkey-endpoints`

```json
{ "enroll": "https://example.test/settings/security", "manage": "https://example.test/settings/security" }
```

Both keys are `route('security.edit')` (`routes/settings.php`).

### Message formats

Not applicable. No queue, topic, broker client, queued listener or scheduler entry exists: `database/migrations/0001_01_01_000002_create_jobs_table.php` and `config/queue.php` (`default: database`) are untouched framework defaults, `phpunit.xml` forces `QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync`, and `README.md` lists Redis/queues as out of v1 ("sem cache e sem fila; a gravação é síncrona"). The only recurring behavior is client-side timers in `resources/js/prancheta/autosave.ts` and `clock.ts`.
